trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed the most recent healthy production version, **v2.3.0**, across all three regions — rollback verified and approved.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0, and paging the on-call engineer.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is identified and fixed.
